name: guardrails
description: Global editing guardrails as hooks: post-edit lint & type-check (JS/TS/Python), an LLM scope-cop that blocks UI edits drifting from the approved plan, and an Agent Teams misuse guard. Portable across machines — replaces hand-rolled hooks in ~/.claude/settings.json. Run /guardrails:setup once per machine to set the env var and clear the old hooks.
